content: Vulkan's precompiled SPIR-V shader format reduces (but does not eliminate) cross-vendor interpretation variance compared to OpenGL's source-level shader compilation. However no source found guarantees bit-exact pixel output across GPU vendors/drivers for floating-point rasterization -- rounding/blending/interpolation order can still differ. Practical determinism for verification purposes is best achieved by controlling the variable tightly (same GPU/driver, or a software rasterizer) rather than assuming cross-vendor bit-exactness.
